meaning.en: Simple past tense and past participle of colorize.
meaning.vi: Thì quá khứ đơn và quá khứ phân từ của sự tô màu.

sentences.en: Wilson added these wicked colorized backtraces that enable you to quickly pick out the ultimate failure line and some significant points in the backtrace.

sentences.en: What I ended up with was a colorized version of this Daguerreotype.

sentences.en: Rendering colorized photorealistic facial images and complicated attributes are important research topics in this field.

sentences.en: The colorized steel press moulding tile and C/Z type purline moulding machine abroad apply for all kinds of industry workshop , storage and high building .

sentences.en: Each colorized pixel point maps a value, and a dimensional data is displayed in different section for partitioning section of rotundity.
